source: Jakeschincariol/x-agent-skill x-post hooks.json (X-01..21, source order and classify_order); X-22+ from sergebulaev/x-skills and liftli/x
evidence: craft; performance notes in best_for are folklore unless labelled
rules: Line 1 must work if it is the only line read.
No link, hashtag or @ in line 1.
If the hook would work with anybody else's name on it, it is not the user's hook.
No formula more than 2x per week.
Examples show shape only; never reuse their numbers.

hooks.name: Contrarian Take
hooks.template: Everyone says {common advice}. {Specific experience} says otherwise.
hooks.example: Everyone says post three times a day. My best month on here was eight posts.
hooks.trap: The belief must be genuinely common.
match: \b(unpopular opinion|hot take|controversial|everyone (says|thinks|tells you|is wrong)|most people (think|believe|say)|stop (telling|saying)|is (overrated|a lie|dead)|nobody wants to hear)\b

hooks.name: Number Reveal
hooks.template: I {did thing} for {N} {days/weeks}. Here's what actually happened.
hooks.example: I posted every day for 30 days. Here's what actually happened.
hooks.trap: The result must land in line 1-2, not post 7.

hooks.name: Cost Confession
hooks.template: {Specific amount} is what {one mistake} cost me.
hooks.example: $18,000 is what one missing clause cost me.
hooks.trap: A fake cost ('my peace of mind').

hooks.name: Before/After
hooks.template: {Time} ago I {low}. Today I {high}. One thing changed.
hooks.example: A year ago I {low state}. Today I {high state}. One thing changed.

hooks.name: The List
hooks.template: {N} {things} {specific audience} should {do/know}:
hooks.example: 5 prompts every solo founder should keep in a notes file:

hooks.name: Nobody Tells You
hooks.template: Nobody tells you {true, specific, slightly uncomfortable thing}.
hooks.example: Nobody tells you the second product is harder to sell than the first.

hooks.name: The Hottest New
hooks.template: The hottest new {familiar category} is {unexpected thing}.
hooks.example: The hottest new programming language is English.
hooks.best_for: reframing (claimed most reposted shape on AI Twitter: folklore)

hooks.name: Credential Setup
hooks.template: I'm {name} and I {built/run}. Here's my exact setup.
hooks.example: I'm {name} and I run {real thing}. Here's my exact setup.
hooks.trap: The credential must be real and checkable.

hooks.name: Time Anchor
hooks.template: {Task} used to take me {long}. It now takes {short}.
hooks.example: Writing a week of posts used to take me 5 hours. It now takes 20 minutes.
hooks.trap: An unbelievable ratio reads as an ad (5h->20min ok, 5h->5s not).

hooks.name: Someone Else's Result
hooks.template: {Specific person} {did surprising thing} with {approach}.
hooks.example: {Named person} {real result} with {approach}. Link in reply.

hooks.name: Prediction
hooks.template: In {timeframe}, {specific change} will {happen}. {Why}.
hooks.example: In 12 months, most coding interviews will allow AI. The take-home is already dead.

hooks.name: Command
hooks.template: {Imperative} {specific thing}. {Reason}.
hooks.example: Delete the first line of every post you draft. It's almost always throat-clearing.
hooks.best_for: bookmarks; the reason is the post

hooks.name: Statistic
hooks.template: {Surprising figure} of {group} {do}. {Meaning}.
hooks.example: 3 of my last 40 posts brought in 71% of my new followers.

hooks.name: Coinage
hooks.template: There's a new kind of {activity} I call "{name}". {What it is}.
hooks.example: There's a new kind of debugging I call "vibe archaeology".
hooks.trap: Naming something that already has a name.

hooks.name: Launch
hooks.template: {New thing} just {shipped}. {The one detail}.
hooks.example: {Product} just shipped {feature}. The one detail that matters: {detail}.

hooks.name: Thread Promise
hooks.template: I {spent N hours doing X}. Here's everything I learned:
hooks.example: I spent 40 hours reading model release notes. Here's everything I learned:

hooks.name: Regret
hooks.template: I wasted {time} on {thing}. {Instead}.
hooks.example: I wasted a year on a course. A weekend of building taught me more.

hooks.name: Comparison
hooks.template: {Expensive/known} vs {cheap/new}. {Which won, by how much}.
hooks.example: $20 tool vs $2,000 agency. The tool won on speed, lost on taste.

hooks.name: Field Report
hooks.template: I've been {spending time with group} lately. {What you noticed}.
hooks.example: I've been talking to new grads lately. None of them want to be managers.

hooks.name: Open Question
hooks.template: {Question only your audience can answer}?
hooks.example: What's the one $20/month tool you'd cancel last?

hooks.name: One-Liner
hooks.template: {One true short sentence}
hooks.example: Most meetings are status updates with chairs.
hooks.trap: Must be a disagreeable claim, not a vibe.

hooks.name: Build-in-Public Confession
hooks.template:
{Time marker}: {project} did {real metric}.

Here is the part nobody tweets: {honest cost/mistake}.
hooks.example: Month 3: the side project made {real number}. Here is the part nobody tweets: {real cost}.

hooks.name: Quote-Tweet Value-Add
hooks.template:
{One line that reframes or respectfully challenges}.

{The missing nuance / counter-example}.
hooks.example: True for teams of 50. At 5 people the opposite holds: {reason}.

hooks.name: Third-Person Case Study
hooks.template:
{Person/faceless thing} {achieved specific $ outcome} {doing something ordinary}.

{Line that sharpens the how}.
hooks.example: {Real named account} made {real $} {doing ordinary thing}. Link in reply.
hooks.best_for: reposts and bookmarks (claimed common winner in a ~450-post corpus: folklore)

hooks.name: Curiosity Gap
hooks.template:
{Surprising outcome as fact}.

I did not expect why. Here is what actually happened.
hooks.example: Our slowest feature had the best retention. I did not expect why.

hooks.name: How-I Teardown
hooks.template:
How I {result with number} in {timeframe}.

The exact steps, nothing held back.
hooks.example: How I cut our CI time from 18 to 6 minutes in a week. The exact steps.
hooks.best_for: bookmarks (rare among real over-performers: craft caveat)
hooks.trap: The result is not provably yours.

hooks.name: Hidden Cause
hooks.template: {Outcome}. It had nothing to do with {obvious cause}.
hooks.example: Our signups doubled in May. It had nothing to do with the launch.
hooks.trap: The real cause is never named.

hooks.name: Two Types
hooks.template: {A} does one thing. {B} does the opposite. {Which wins}.
hooks.example: Junior devs ask how. Senior devs ask why not. One gets promoted.
